note: Scenario skins: the same generated instance rendered as a different realistic conflict. A skin names the two parties, the artifact, the decisions and their options; the generator still draws the weights, so no option is systematically better. Option names are meant to carry as little prior as possible. 'abstract' is the default rendering (Decision 1, Option A). 'thing' is the word used for the object being negotiated (design, plan).

software_design.artifact: the design of a shared module
software_design.intro: You each own one feature of the same service, and both features go through this module, so its design decides how much work each of you has and how well your feature performs.

team_plan.artifact: a quarterly plan for both teams
team_plan.intro: Your two teams share one budget, one office and one review process, and the plan you agree on applies to both teams.
